rules.name: Abnormal Lab → Patient Notification
rules.description: Abnormal lab results must be communicated to the patient within 3 days
references: Callen JL et al. J Gen Intern Med 2012;27:1334-1348

rules.name: Abnormal Lab → Follow-up Appointment
rules.description: Abnormal lab results require a follow-up appointment within 14 days
references: Singh H et al. BMJ Qual Saf 2014

rules.name: Incidental Lung Nodule → Fleischner Follow-up CT
rules.description: Incidental lung nodule needing follow-up under Fleischner 2017 (by size, solid / part-solid / ground-glass, single / multiple, risk, and stepped follow-up of a known nodule)
references: Fleischner Society 2017 Guidelines
Lacson R et al. JACR 2020
rules.evidence_note: Deadline from the Fleischner 2017 table (upper bound of the interval): solid 6–8 mm 12 months, >8 mm 3 months, multiple 3–6 months, ground-glass ≥6 mm 12 months, part-solid ≥6 mm 3–6 months; stepped follow-up for a stable nodule; unknown risk managed as high risk. Lung nodules only, not screening LDCT (Lung-RADS). Age <35, known cancer or immunocompromise → human review. Tissue sampling also closes the loop.

rules.name: Elevated PSA → Urology Referral / Biopsy
rules.description: Significantly elevated PSA requires urological evaluation
references: AUA/SUO Early Detection of Prostate Cancer 2023

rules.name: Abnormal Cervical Cytology → Colposcopy Referral
rules.description: Abnormal cervical cytology needs clinician risk assessment and an appropriate follow-up plan
references: ASCCP 2019 Risk-Based Management Guidelines
rules.evidence_note: 30 days is a proposed local tracking target, not a universal ASCCP deadline. Confirm cytology, HPV, age, pregnancy and screening history with a clinician. A recorded referral satisfies this referral task; it does not prove colposcopy or treatment occurred.

rules.name: Post-discharge Positive Culture → Callback
rules.name_ko: 퇴원 후 배양 양성 → 환자 연락
rules.description: Positive blood/urine culture finalized after discharge requires urgent callback
references: CDC DxEx Core Elements 2026

rules.name: Warfarin Dose Change → INR Recheck
rules.description: Any warfarin/anticoagulant dose change requires INR recheck within 7 days
references: ACCP Antithrombotic Therapy Guidelines

rules.name: Specialist Referral → Referral Visit
rules.description: A specialist referral should be completed within 30 days
references: AHRQ/PSNet Health IT Safe Practices

rules.name: Abnormal Pathology → Notification + Referral
rules.name_ko: 병리 이상 → 환자 통보 + 전문의 의뢰
rules.description: Abnormal pathology results require patient notification and specialist referral, both within 5 days
references: Singh H et al. BMJ Qual Saf 2014

rules.name: Medication Change → Follow-up Labs
rules.description: New medication or dose change requires follow-up labs within 14 days
references: ISMP Medication Safety Best Practices

rules.name: Normal Lab → Provider Review
rules.description: Even normal results should be reviewed/acknowledged by ordering provider
references: AHRQ Closing the Loop on Test Results

rules.name: Abnormal Thyroid Function → Follow-up Labs
rules.description: Abnormal TSH/T4 requires repeat labs within 6-8 weeks
references: ATA Hypothyroidism Guidelines 2014

guideline_alerts.title: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes
guideline_alerts.current_ref: American Diabetes Association. Standards of Care in Diabetes-2026. Diabetes Care 2026;49(Suppl 1)
guideline_alerts.change: Annual update: check the relevant section of the current edition
guideline_alerts.reference: ADA Standards of Medical Care in Diabetes 2024

rules.name: Uncontrolled HbA1c (≥9%) → Repeat HbA1c in 3 Months
rules.description: Patients with HbA1c ≥9% require repeat testing within 90 days per ADA Standards of Care
references: ADA Standards of Medical Care in Diabetes 2024

rules.name: Post-MI Discharge → Cardiology Follow-up ≤14 Days
rules.description: Post-myocardial infarction discharge requires cardiology outpatient review within 14 days
references: ACC/AHA 2021 Heart Attack Guideline

rules.name: Positive Blood Culture (Bacteremia) → Repeat Culture at 48h
rules.description: Any positive blood culture for bacteremia requires repeat culture within 48 hours to confirm clearance
references: IDSA Bacteremia Management Guidelines 2024
CDC Core Elements 2026

rules.name: New Heart Failure Diagnosis → Echocardiogram
rules.description: New diagnosis of heart failure requires echocardiogram within 30 days per ACC/AHA guidelines
references: ACC/AHA 2022 Heart Failure Guidelines

rules.name: Positive FIT → Diagnostic Colonoscopy
rules.description: A positive fecal immunochemical test requires diagnostic colonoscopy
references: Corley DA et al. JAMA 2017;317:1631-1641
Korean National Cancer Screening Program (FIT from age 50)
rules.evidence_note: Risk of advanced-stage cancer rises with longer FIT+-to-colonoscopy intervals; programme targets are often shorter than 90 days.

rules.name: Mammography BI-RADS 4/5 → Tissue Diagnosis
rules.description: Suspicious (BI-RADS 4) or highly suggestive (BI-RADS 5) findings require biopsy
references: ACR BI-RADS Atlas, 5th ed. (2013)
rules.evidence_note: BI-RADS mandates tissue diagnosis; the 30-day window is a quality target.

rules.name: Lung-RADS 4A → 3-Month LDCT
rules.description: Lung-RADS category 4A on screening LDCT requires 3-month LDCT (or PET/CT)
references: ACR Lung-RADS v2022
rules.evidence_note: Calendar-anchored interval; no additional scheduling grace.

rules.name: Lung-RADS 4B/4X → Diagnostic Work-up
rules.description: Lung-RADS 4B/4X requires diagnostic CT, PET/CT, tissue sampling or referral
references: ACR Lung-RADS v2022
rules.evidence_note: Lung-RADS gives no explicit interval for 4B/4X; 30 days is a proposed target.

rules.name: Abnormal Result After Discharge → Clinician Review
rules.name_ko: 퇴원 후 이상 결과 → 의료진 확인
rules.description: An abnormal result finalised after the patient left hospital must be reviewed by a responsible clinician
references: Roy CL et al. Ann Intern Med 2005;143:121-128

rules.name: Critical Value → Documented Clinician Notification ≤1 Hour
rules.description: A critical (panic) result must be communicated to a responsible clinician and documented
references: CLSI GP47 Management of Critical- and Significant-Risk Results
The Joint Commission NPSG.02.03.01
rules.evidence_note: Institutions set the exact window; 1 hour is a common upper limit.

rules.name: Heart Failure Discharge → Clinic Visit ≤7 Days
rules.description: Patients discharged after heart failure hospitalisation need an early follow-up visit
references: Heidenreich PA et al. 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Heart Failure Guideline. Circulation 2022

rules.name: Hypertensive Disorder of Pregnancy → Postpartum BP Check
rules.name_ko: 임신성 고혈압 질환 → 산후 혈압 측정
rules.description: Postpartum blood pressure evaluation: within 72 hours if severe, otherwise within 7–10 days
references: ACOG Committee Opinion No. 736: Optimizing Postpartum Care (2018)

guideline_alerts.title: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes
guideline_alerts.current_ref: American Diabetes Association. Standards of Care in Diabetes-2026. Diabetes Care 2026;49(Suppl 1)
guideline_alerts.change: Annual update: check the relevant section of the current edition
guideline_alerts.reference: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes 2024, Section 15

rules.name: Gestational Diabetes → Postpartum Glucose Test (4–12 Weeks)
rules.description: Women with gestational diabetes need a 75 g OGTT 4–12 weeks after delivery
references: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes 2024, Section 15
ACOG Practice Bulletin No. 190

rules.name: HCV Antibody Positive → HCV RNA Test
rules.name_ko: C형간염 항체 양성 → HCV RNA 검사
rules.description: A reactive hepatitis C antibody needs an RNA test to establish current infection
references: CDC Recommendations for Hepatitis C Screening Among Adults, MMWR 2020;69(RR-2)
rules.evidence_note: CDC recommends reflex RNA testing on the same specimen; 30 days is a proposed outer limit.

rules.name: HCC Risk (Chronic HBV / Cirrhosis) → Liver Surveillance Imaging
rules.description: Patients at high risk of hepatocellular carcinoma need liver ultrasound every 6 months
references: KASL-NCC 2022 HCC Practice Guideline
AASLD 2023 HCC Practice Guidance
rules.evidence_note: 6-month interval plus 1 month scheduling tolerance.

rules.name: HCC Surveillance Imaging → Next Imaging in 6 Months
rules.description: Each surveillance ultrasound in a high-risk patient starts the next 6-month interval
references: KASL-NCC 2022 HCC Practice Guideline
AASLD 2023 HCC Practice Guidance
rules.evidence_note: 6-month interval plus 1 month scheduling tolerance.

rules.name: Self-Harm or Psychiatric Discharge → Mental-Health Follow-up ≤7 Days
rules.description: After an ED visit for self-harm or a psychiatric admission, follow-up within 7 days
references: NCQA HEDIS FUH / FUM 7-day follow-up measures
rules.evidence_note: Deploy only with psychiatry co-design and crisis protocols. Clinician-handled: ClinLoop never contacts the patient for this rule.

rules.name: Radiologist-Recommended CT
rules.description: Follow-up CT recommended in the radiology report, within the stated interval
references: ACR Actionable Reporting Work Group, JACR 2014;11:552-558
rules.evidence_note: Interval from the report without additional scheduling grace. The follow-up study must cover the body region the recommendation names (an abdominal CT covers the adrenals; a head CT does not).

rules.name: Radiologist-Recommended MRI
rules.description: Follow-up MRI recommended in the radiology report, within the stated interval
references: ACR Actionable Reporting Work Group, JACR 2014;11:552-558
rules.evidence_note: Interval from the report without additional scheduling grace. The follow-up study must cover the body region the recommendation names (an abdominal CT covers the adrenals; a head CT does not).

rules.name: Radiologist-Recommended Ultrasound
rules.description: Follow-up ultrasound recommended in the radiology report, within the stated interval
references: ACR Actionable Reporting Work Group, JACR 2014;11:552-558
rules.evidence_note: Interval from the report without additional scheduling grace. The follow-up study must cover the body region the recommendation names (an abdominal CT covers the adrenals; a head CT does not).

rules.name: Radiologist-Recommended Radiograph
rules.description: Follow-up radiograph (e.g. chest X-ray to document resolution) recommended in the report
references: ACR Actionable Reporting Work Group, JACR 2014;11:552-558
BTS Guidelines for community-acquired pneumonia in adults (2009): repeat CXR ~6 weeks
rules.evidence_note: Interval from the report without additional scheduling grace. A recommendation without an interval uses a 30-day default. The follow-up radiograph must cover the same body region.

rules.name: Lung-RADS 3 → 6-Month LDCT
rules.description: Lung-RADS category 3 on screening LDCT requires 6-month LDCT
references: ACR Lung-RADS v2022
rules.evidence_note: Calendar-anchored interval; no additional scheduling grace.

rules.name: Critical Imaging Finding → Documented Clinician Communication ≤1 Hour
rules.name_ko: 영상 위급 소견 → 1시간 내 의료진 직접 보고
rules.description: An emergent imaging finding (e.g. acute PE, aortic dissection, intracranial haemorrhage, pneumothorax, free air) must be communicated directly to a responsible clinician
references: ACR Practice Parameter for Communication of Diagnostic Imaging Findings (2020)
The Joint Commission NPSG.02.03.01
rules.evidence_note: Closed by a documented communication: a FHIR Communication, or a statement in the report itself ('discussed with Dr …', 'communicated to …'). Institutions set the window and the list of critical findings.

rules.name: Radiologist-Recommended Tissue Sampling → Biopsy/FNA
rules.description: Biopsy or fine-needle aspiration recommended in the radiology report (e.g. TI-RADS, renal or liver mass)
references: ACR Actionable Reporting Work Group, JACR 2014;11:552-558
ACR TI-RADS, JACR 2017;14:587-595
rules.evidence_note: 30 days is a proposed target. Not applied when BI-RADS, Lung-RADS or the lung-nodule rule already governs the same finding.

rules.name: Incidental Adrenal Nodule → Adrenal CT/MRI
rules.description: Indeterminate adrenal nodule 1–4 cm needs adrenal protocol CT or MRI (12 months for 1–2 cm)
references: ACR Incidental Findings: adrenal (Mayo-Smith WW et al. JACR 2017;14:1038-1044)
rules.evidence_note: 1–2 cm: 12 months; 2–4 cm: characterise (90 days, proposed). Benign features (adenoma ≤10 HU, myelolipoma, stable ≥1 year) are excluded. Follow-up must cover the adrenals.

rules.name: Adrenal Mass ≥4 cm (or Nodule with Known Cancer) → Specialist Work-up
rules.name_ko: 부신 종괴 ≥4cm(또는 암 환자) → 전문의 정밀검사
rules.description: Adrenal mass ≥4 cm, or adrenal nodule ≥1 cm in a patient with cancer, needs referral, PET/CT or biopsy
references: ACR Incidental Findings: adrenal (Mayo-Smith WW et al. JACR 2017;14:1038-1044)
rules.evidence_note: 30 days is a proposed target. Biochemical (hormonal) evaluation is also advised and is not tracked.

rules.name: Suspicious Renal Mass → Urology Referral
rules.description: Solid enhancing renal mass or Bosniak III/IV cyst needs urology referral or biopsy
references: ACR Incidental Findings: renal (Herts BR et al. JACR 2018;15:264-273)
Silverman SG et al. Bosniak v2019. Radiology 2019;292:475-488
rules.evidence_note: 30 days is a proposed target.

rules.name: Indeterminate Renal Lesion / Bosniak IIF → Renal CT/MRI
rules.name_ko: 불확정 신장 병변/Bosniak IIF → 신장 CT/MRI
rules.description: Indeterminate renal lesion ≥1 cm or Bosniak IIF cyst needs renal mass protocol CT or MRI
references: ACR Incidental Findings: renal (Herts BR et al. JACR 2018;15:264-273)
Silverman SG et al. Bosniak v2019. Radiology 2019;292:475-488
rules.evidence_note: Bosniak IIF: 6 months; indeterminate ≥1 cm: 90 days (proposed). Simple cysts, Bosniak I–II, angiomyolipoma and lesions too small to characterise are excluded.

rules.name: Incidental Pancreatic Cyst → MRI/MRCP Surveillance
rules.description: Incidental pancreatic cyst needs MRI/MRCP surveillance at a size-based interval
references: ACR Incidental Findings: pancreatic cysts (Megibow AJ et al. JACR 2017;14:911-923)
rules.evidence_note: <1.5 cm: 2 years; 1.5–2.5 cm: 1 year; >2.5 cm: 6 months or EUS-FNA. ACR also adjusts by age (≥80) and growth: specialist review required.

rules.name: Pancreatic Cyst with Worrisome Features → EUS / Specialist
rules.name_ko: 우려 소견 동반 췌장 낭종 → 내시경초음파/전문의
rules.description: Pancreatic cyst with main duct ≥7 mm, mural nodule or solid component needs EUS or pancreas specialist
references: ACR Incidental Findings: pancreatic cysts (Megibow AJ et al. JACR 2017;14:911-923)
rules.evidence_note: 30 days is a proposed target.

rules.name: Incidental Thyroid Nodule on CT/MRI/PET → Thyroid Ultrasound
rules.name_ko: CT/MRI/PET 우연 갑상선 결절 → 갑상선 초음파
rules.description: Thyroid nodule ≥1.5 cm (≥1 cm under 35), with suspicious features, or FDG-avid needs thyroid ultrasound
references: ACR Incidental Findings: thyroid (Hoang JK et al. JACR 2015;12:143-150)
rules.evidence_note: 90 days is a proposed target. Age unknown → the 1 cm threshold is used. On thyroid ultrasound, ACR TI-RADS criteria apply instead (R036 FNA, R032 follow-up).

rules.name: Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm → Surveillance Imaging
rules.description: Incidental abdominal aortic dilatation ≥2.5 cm needs surveillance imaging at a diameter-based interval
references: ACR Incidental Findings: vascular (Khosa F et al. JACR 2013;10:789-794)
Chaikof EL et al. SVS AAA guidelines. J Vasc Surg 2018;67:2-77
rules.evidence_note: 2.5–2.9 cm 5 years; 3.0–3.4 cm 3 years; 3.5–3.9 cm 2 years; 4.0–4.4 cm 1 year; ≥4.5 cm 6 months.

rules.name: Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm at Repair Threshold → Vascular Surgery
rules.description: AAA ≥5.5 cm (≥5.0 cm in women) needs vascular surgery referral
references: Chaikof EL et al. SVS AAA guidelines. J Vasc Surg 2018;67:2-77
ACR Incidental Findings: vascular (Khosa F et al. JACR 2013)
rules.evidence_note: 14 days is a proposed target; a symptomatic or ruptured aneurysm is a critical finding (R035).

rules.name: Growing or Suspicious Lung Nodule → Work-up
rules.description: Lung nodule that grew, or persistent part-solid nodule with solid component ≥6 mm, needs PET/CT, tissue sampling or specialist referral
rules.ltl_formula: □(RADIOLOGY_REPORT[nodule growth ∨ persistent part-solid ≥6 mm solid] → ◇_{≤30d} (PET ∨ BIOPSY ∨ REFERRAL))
references: Fleischner Society 2017 (MacMahon H et al. Radiology 2017;284:228-243)
rules.evidence_note: Growth = report says so, or ≥2 mm larger than the patient's previous report. 30 days is a proposed target.

rules.name: Imaging-AI Finding Not Addressed in the Report → Radiologist Review
rules.name_ko: 영상 AI 소견이 판독문에 없음 → 영상의학과 재검토
rules.description: An imaging-AI product flagged a finding (e.g. lung nodule, pneumothorax) that the radiology report does not mention; a radiologist must review the images and document a decision
references: ACR Data Science Institute: AI in clinical practice (second-reader use)
MFDS 인공지능 의료기기 허가·심사 가이드라인
rules.evidence_note: The AI is a second reader, never a diagnosis. Critical findings (pneumothorax, free air, intracranial haemorrhage) are due within 1 day. Closed by a report or addendum that addresses the finding (confirming or refuting it), or by a clinician closing the loop with evidence. Findings from research-use models count only when the hospital enables them.

rules.name: Note Plan: Repeat Lab Test
rules.description: A clinician's note plans to repeat or check a lab test (e.g. 'repeat potassium in 1 week')
references: Singh H et al. Missed follow-up of test results. JAMA Intern Med 2013;173:702-704
Joint Commission Sentinel Event Alert 47 (diagnostic error, follow-up of results)
rules.evidence_note: Closed by a result of the same test (potassium plan → potassium result). 'Repeat labs' with no named test is closed by any lab result. Interval from the note without additional scheduling grace; 30 days when the note states none. Conditional, cancelled or already-done plans are not tracked.

rules.name: Note Plan: Imaging
rules.description: A clinician's note plans an imaging study (e.g. 'CT chest in 3 months', '3개월 후 흉부 CT')
rules.ltl_formula: □(NOTE_PLAN[imaging M of region R in T] → ◇_{≤T} IMAGING[M ∧ covers R])
references: Callen JL et al. Failure to follow-up test results for ambulatory patients. J Gen Intern Med 2012;27:1334-48
rules.evidence_note: Closed only by a study of the same modality that covers the region the note names. Interval from the note without additional scheduling grace; 90 days when the note states none.

rules.name: Note Plan: Specialist Referral
rules.description: A clinician's note plans a referral (e.g. 'refer to cardiology', '심장내과 협진 의뢰')
references: Gandhi TK et al. Communication breakdown in the outpatient referral process. J Gen Intern Med 2000;15:626-31
rules.evidence_note: Closed by a referral order or a visit to the same specialty. 30 days when the note states no interval.

rules.name: Note Plan: Follow-up Visit
rules.description: A clinician's note plans a follow-up visit (e.g. 'RTC 6 weeks', '6주 후 외래 재방문')
references: Joint Commission Sentinel Event Alert 47 (diagnostic error, follow-up)
rules.evidence_note: Closed by a follow-up appointment that took place. Booked-but-not-attended visits do not count.

rules.name: Iron-Deficiency Anaemia → GI Investigation
rules.description: Low haemoglobin and low ferritin within 90 days in a man ≥ 18 or a woman ≥ 50, with no colonoscopy or GI referral in the past year: investigate for gastrointestinal (colorectal) cancer
references: Snook J et al. BSG guidelines for the management of iron deficiency anaemia in adults. Gut 2021;70:2030-51
NICE NG12: Suspected cancer: recognition and referral (IDA ≥ 60 years)
rules.evidence_note: Thresholds: Hb < 13 g/dL (men) / < 12 g/dL (women), ferritin < 30 µg/L. Women under 50 are excluded (menstrual loss is the usual cause); clinicians may still investigate. Age ≥ 60: 14 days.

rules.name: Creatinine Rise (AKI Warning) → Repeat Creatinine
rules.description: Creatinine ≥ 1.5 × baseline and ≥ 0.3 mg/dL higher: acute kidney injury until shown otherwise
references: KDIGO Clinical Practice Guideline for Acute Kidney Injury. Kidney Int Suppl 2012;2:1-138
NICE NG148: Acute kidney injury (AKI detection algorithm)
rules.evidence_note: Baseline: lowest creatinine in the previous 7 days, else the median of the previous 8–365 days (NHS England AKI algorithm). Same unit only. Closed by a repeat creatinine.

guideline_alerts.title: ESC Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation
guideline_alerts.current_ref: Van Gelder IC et al. 2024 ESC Guidelines for atrial fibrillation. Eur Heart J 2024;45:3314-3414
guideline_alerts.change: Stroke risk uses CHA2DS2-VA (sex no longer scores); oral anticoagulation recommended at a score >= 2 for everyone
guideline_alerts.reference: Hindricks G et al. 2020 ESC Guidelines for atrial fibrillation. Eur Heart J 2021;42:373-498

rules.name: Atrial Fibrillation, High Stroke Risk → Anticoagulation Decision
rules.description: Atrial fibrillation with CHA₂DS₂-VASc ≥ 2 (men) / ≥ 3 (women) and no anticoagulant: decide on anticoagulation (or document why not)
references: Hindricks G et al. 2020 ESC Guidelines for atrial fibrillation. Eur Heart J 2021;42:373-498
Joglar JA et al. 2023 ACC/AHA/ACCP/HRS Guideline for Atrial Fibrillation. Circulation 2024;149:e1-e156
rules.evidence_note: CHA₂DS₂-VASc from the problem list (heart failure, hypertension, diabetes, stroke/TIA, vascular disease), age and sex. A clinician closes the loop with evidence when anticoagulation is contraindicated or declined.

rules.name: Persistent Microscopic Haematuria → Urology Evaluation
rules.description: ≥ 3 RBC/hpf on two urine tests within 12 months at age ≥ 35: urological evaluation
references: Barocas DA et al. Microhematuria: AUA/SUFU Guideline. J Urol 2020;204:778-86
rules.evidence_note: Two positive tests reduce false alarms (menstruation, exercise). Closed by a urology referral or visit, or a CT covering the urinary tract.

rules.name: Lung Nodule Measured Larger Across Reports → Review and Work-up
rules.name_ko: 보고서 간 폐결절 크기 증가 → 재검토 및 정밀검사
rules.description: The same lung nodule (linked across reports by lobe and size) is ≥ 2 mm larger than its smallest earlier measurement, and the latest report does not call it growing
rules.ltl_formula: □(NODULE[same lesion, size − min(earlier) ≥ 2 mm] ∧ ¬report says growing → ◇_{≤30d} (PET ∨ BIOPSY ∨ REFERRAL))
references: MacMahon H et al. Fleischner Society 2017. Radiology 2017;284:228-243
Callister MEJ et al. BTS guidelines for pulmonary nodules. Thorax 2015;70:ii1-ii54
rules.evidence_note: Catches growth that is never written down: 'stable 8 mm' after 6 mm, or 6 → 7 → 8 mm over three scans. The lesion match is probable, so the loop asks a radiologist to confirm it; a re-measurement showing no growth closes it with evidence. Volume-doubling time < 400 days is flagged as suspicious.

rules.name: Critical Imaging-AI Finding on an Unreported Study → Read the Study Now
rules.name_ko: 판독 전 검사의 영상 AI 위급 소견 → 즉시 판독
rules.description: An approved imaging-AI product flagged a critical finding (intracranial haemorrhage, pneumothorax, free intraperitoneal air) on a study that has no radiology report yet; a radiologist must read it
references: ACR Practice Parameter for Communication of Diagnostic Imaging Findings (2020)
FDA: Computer-assisted triage and notification software (CADt), 21 CFR 892.2080
MFDS 인공지능 의료기기 허가·심사 가이드라인
rules.evidence_note: Worklist triage, the purpose of approved triage products: the AI result moves the study up, it never diagnoses or reaches the patient. Closed by the first report of the same study (StudyInstanceUID, or the first report after the study covering its body region); R047 then checks that the report addressed the finding. Not raised when the study was already reported. 60 minutes is the default (CLINLOOP_AI_CRITICAL_READ_MINUTES); research-use products count only when the hospital enables them.

rules.name: Report Item No Rule Tracked (Second Reader) → Clinician Review
rules.name_ko: 규칙이 놓친 판독문 조치 사항(2차 판독 모델) → 의료진 검토
rules.description: The hospital's own language model, reading the report as a second reader, found an action the report calls for (follow-up imaging, work-up, referral, a critical finding, abnormal pathology) that no rule tracked; a clinician reads the report and acts or closes it as not needed
rules.ltl_formula: □(SECOND_READER_FLAG[quote verified ∧ no rule opened] → ◇_{≤7d} (matching follow-up ∨ clinician closes))
references: Singh H et al. Types and origins of diagnostic errors in primary care. JAMA Intern Med 2013;173:418-25
Lacson R et al. Factors associated with radiologists' recommendations. JACR 2015
rules.evidence_note: A safety net for the rules' long tail. Every flag quotes the report word for word (or is discarded), only items no rule tracked are flagged, and each is marked for human review: the model never opens or closes a clinical obligation itself. Closed by the follow-up of its kind (imaging, work-up, referral, communication) or by a clinician. Critical findings 1 day, pathology 3 days, otherwise 7 days to review. On-premise model only; off unless CLINLOOP_SECOND_READER=1.

rules.name: Prolonged QTc ≥500 ms → Medication Review / Repeat ECG ≤24 h
rules.name_ko: QTc 500ms 이상 연장 → 24시간 내 약물 검토·심전도 재검
rules.description: An ECG with a corrected QT interval of 500 ms or more: a clinician reviews QT-prolonging medicines and electrolytes, and repeats the ECG, within 24 hours
references: Drew BJ et al. Prevention of torsade de pointes in hospital settings: AHA/ACCF scientific statement. Circulation 2010;121:1047-60
Rautaharju PM et al. AHA/ACCF/HRS recommendations for the standardization and interpretation of the ECG, part IV (ST segment, T and U waves, QT interval). Circulation 2009;119:e241-50
rules.evidence_note: QTc ≥ 500 ms (or a rise of ≥ 60 ms) markedly raises the risk of torsade de pointes. The repeat ECG or a documented review closes it; the review checks QT-prolonging drugs, potassium and magnesium.

rules.name: Reactive HIV Screening Test → Supplemental Test or HIV Care ≤30 Days
rules.name_ko: HIV 선별검사 반응성 → 30일 내 확인검사·HIV 진료 연계
rules.description: A reactive HIV-1/2 antigen/antibody (or rapid antibody) screening test needs a supplemental test (HIV-1/HIV-2 differentiation assay or HIV-1 RNA) and linkage to HIV care
references: CDC and APHL. Laboratory Testing for the Diagnosis of HIV Infection: Updated Recommendations. 2014; Technical update 2018
CDC. Understanding the HIV Care Continuum: linkage to care within 30 days of diagnosis
rules.evidence_note: Supplemental testing is normally reflexed on the same specimen. A known HIV diagnosis on the problem list does not trigger it; an indeterminate screen is shown for review, not tracked.

rules.name: HBsAg Positive → HBV DNA or Specialist Evaluation ≤30 Days
rules.name_ko: B형간염 표면항원 양성 → 30일 내 HBV DNA·전문의 평가
rules.description: A positive hepatitis B surface antigen means hepatitis B infection: evaluate with HBV DNA (and HBeAg, ALT) or refer to hepatology, gastroenterology or infectious disease
references: Terrault NA et al. Update on prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of chronic hepatitis B: AASLD 2018 hepatitis B guidance. Hepatology 2018;67:1560-99
rules.evidence_note: Anti-HBs (surface antibody) is immunity and anti-HBc alone is not this rule. A known chronic hepatitis B diagnosis does not trigger it (liver-cancer surveillance is R027). 30 days is a proposed limit.

rules.name: Positive TB Infection Test (IGRA / TST ≥10 mm) → Chest Radiograph ≤30 Days
rules.name_ko: 결핵 감염검사 양성(IGRA/TST ≥10mm) → 30일 내 흉부 X선
rules.description: A positive interferon-gamma release assay or a tuberculin skin test of 10 mm or more: a chest radiograph to exclude active tuberculosis before latent TB treatment
references: Lewinsohn DM et al. Official ATS/IDSA/CDC Clinical Practice Guidelines: Diagnosis of Tuberculosis in Adults and Children. Clin Infect Dis 2017;64:e1-e33
Sterling TR et al. Guidelines for the Treatment of Latent TB Infection: NTCA and CDC, 2020. MMWR Recomm Rep 2020;69(RR-1)
rules.evidence_note: The TST cut-off is 5, 10 or 15 mm by risk group; 10 mm is used here. Indeterminate or borderline IGRA results are shown for review, not tracked. Closed by chest imaging only.

rules.name: Colonoscopy Findings → Surveillance Colonoscopy at the USMSTF Interval
rules.name_ko: 대장내시경 소견 → 지침 간격의 감시 대장내시경
rules.description: Inadequate bowel preparation (repeat within 1 year), piecemeal resection of a polyp ≥ 20 mm (6 months), or advanced findings (adenoma ≥ 10 mm, villous histology, high-grade dysplasia, ≥ 5 adenomas, serrated lesion ≥ 10 mm or with dysplasia, traditional serrated adenoma: 3 years)
references: Gupta S et al. Recommendations for Follow-Up After Colonoscopy and Polypectomy: US Multi-Society Task Force on Colorectal Cancer. Gastroenterology 2020;158:1131-53
Kaminski MF et al. Post-polypectomy surveillance: ESGE Guideline Update 2020. Endoscopy 2020;52:687-700
rules.evidence_note: The interval comes from the endoscopy and pathology reports of one colonoscopy, read together (the shortest applies). Intervals over 3 years (1–4 small adenomas: 3–10 years) are not tracked. Cancer follows the pathology pathway (R009). A colonoscopy within 30 days (completion or re-resection) is not surveillance.

rules.name: Severe Aortic Stenosis on Echocardiogram → Cardiology / Heart Valve Team ≤30 Days
rules.name_ko: 심초음파 중증 대동맥판 협착 → 30일 내 순환기내과·판막팀
rules.description: Severe aortic stenosis (AVA < 1.0 cm², mean gradient ≥ 40 mmHg, peak velocity ≥ 4.0 m/s, or stated as severe): cardiology or heart valve team evaluation
references: Otto CM et al. 2020 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Management of Patients With Valvular Heart Disease. Circulation 2021;143:e72-e227
rules.evidence_note: Symptomatic severe AS carries a high short-term mortality without valve replacement. A prosthetic aortic valve is excluded (native-valve criteria). 30 days is a proposed limit.

rules.name: New LVEF ≤40% on Echocardiogram → Cardiology / Heart-Failure Care ≤30 Days
rules.description: An ejection fraction of 40% or less (or severely reduced LV function) in a patient without known heart failure: cardiology evaluation to start guideline-directed therapy
references: Heidenreich PA et al. 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure. Circulation 2022;145:e895-e1032
rules.evidence_note: A range is judged by its upper value (35–40% counts, 40–45% does not). A patient with heart failure or cardiomyopathy already on the problem list is not alerted again.
